description: Every environment variable the Unfold server reads, beside the configuration file of config.v1.schema.json. A configuration key ending in Env names a further variable that holds a secret; those names are the deployment's choice and are listed under that key, not here. test/config-schema.test.ts fails when src/ reads a variable this file does not list, or this file lists one src/ no longer reads.

variables.name: UNFOLD_CONFIG
variables.description: Configuration file to read; --config wins over it. Without either, Unfold starts from defaults.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MODE
variables.description: Mode; --demo wins over it.

variables.name: UNFOLD_DATA_DIR
variables.description: Directory for the database, workspaces and candidates.

variables.name: UNFOLD_HOST
variables.description: Address the HTTP server binds.

variables.name: UNFOLD_PORT
variables.description: Port the HTTP server listens on.

variables.name: UNFOLD_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public URL people reach Unfold at; https turns on secure cookies and HSTS.

variables.name: UNFOLD_ADMIN_NAME
variables.description: Name of the administrator created at first start; auth.bootstrapName wins over it.

variables.name: UNFOLD_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password of that administrator, at least 12 characters; creates the account only when it is absent and local sign-in is on.

variables.name: UNFOLD_LOCAL_LOGIN
variables.description: Whether people may sign in with a local name and password.

variables.name: UNFOLD_STORE_KEY
variables.description: 32-byte key sealing internal state, as base64, base64url or 64 hex characters. Unset, Unfold keeps a key file next to the database.

variables.name: UNFOLD_GITLAB_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: OAuth application id for linking GitLab accounts.

variables.name: UNFOLD_CLICKUP_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: OAuth application id for linking ClickUp accounts.

variables.name: UNFOLD_FLAGS_FILE
variables.description: flagd file that wins over the inline flag rules and is watched.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
variables.description: Days audit records are kept, 1 to 3650.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OTLP_URL
variables.description: OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint the audit is sent to.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OTLP_HEADERS
variables.description: Headers sent with the audit export, written as OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS writes them.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_ADDR
variables.description: OpenBao address whose Transit key signs the daily audit checkpoints.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_MOUNT
variables.description: Transit secrets engine mount path.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_KEY
variables.description: Transit key name.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_ROLE
variables.description: Kubernetes auth role Unfold signs in to OpenBao as; preferred over a token.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_AUTH_MOUNT
variables.description: Kubernetes auth method mount path.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_OPENBAO_TOKEN
variables.description: OpenBao token instead of a role; environment only.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_URL
variables.description: S3-compatible bucket audit checkpoints are copied to.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_REGION
variables.description: Region in the request signature; auto for Cloudflare R2.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_PREFIX
variables.description: Object key prefix.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_LOCK_DAYS
variables.description: Days S3 Object Lock retains each checkpoint, 1 to 36500.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: Access key id of the checkpoint bucket; environment only.

variables.name: UNFOLD_AUDIT_CHECKPOINT_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: Secret access key of the checkpoint bucket; environment only.

variables.name: UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EVENTS
variables.description: Whether product events from the browser are recorded.

variables.name: UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EXPORT
variables.description: Sink product events are exported to.

variables.name: UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EXPORT_URL
variables.description: Collector URL of the export; required for faro and otlp.

variables.name: UNFOLD_INSIGHT_EXPORT_LEVEL
variables.description: aggregate sends each finished day's rollup; events sends each event with its pseudonymous actor hash.

variables.name: UNFOLD_SENTRY_DSN
variables.description: Sentry-protocol DSN (Sentry, GlitchTip, Bugsink) errors are reported to.

variables.name: UNFOLD_ERROR_OTLP_URL
variables.description: OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint errors are reported to.

variables.name: UNFOLD_ERROR_ENVIRONMENT
variables.description: Environment name error reports carry, such as staging.

variables.name: UNFOLD_PLOEG_MCP_URL
variables.description: Exact resource URL of the remote ploeg-mcp that editors are told about; set together with UNFOLD_PLOEG_MCP_CLIENT_ID.

variables.name: UNFOLD_PLOEG_MCP_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Public OAuth client registered for that server.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_RESOURCE
variables.description: Exact public URL unfold-mcp is served at over HTTP, such as https://unfold.example/mcp; unset turns the HTTP transport off and refuses every other UNFOLD_MCP_ variable.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_ISSUER
variables.description: Issuer of the access tokens unfold-mcp accepts; required with UNFOLD_MCP_RESOURCE.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_JWKS_URL
variables.description: Signing keys of that issuer; discovered from the issuer when unset.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_TOKEN_AUDIENCE
variables.description: Which aud a token must carry: the resource URL, or also one of UNFOLD_MCP_CLIENT_IDS.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_CLIENT_IDS
variables.description: Client ids or Client ID Metadata Document URLs accepted; empty accepts every client of the issuer.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_SCOPE
variables.description: Scope a token must carry.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_REQUEST_SCOPES
variables.description: Scopes clients are told to request; UNFOLD_MCP_SCOPE is always among them.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME
variables.description: Longest accepted token lifetime, such as 10m, at most 24h.

variables.name: UNFOLD_MCP_SUBJECT_NAMESPACE
variables.description: Namespace whose subjects match single sign-on's when the MCP issuer is on another origin.

variables.name: LITELLM_BASE_URL
variables.description: Gateway inference URL including /v1.

variables.name: LITELLM_ADMIN_URL
variables.description: Gateway root the Status page checks.

variables.name: LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
variables.description: Not used under Ploeg, which holds the gateway management credential; leave it unset. Demo mode refuses to start with it.

variables.name: OPENCODE_URL
variables.description: External OpenCode server; selects the external backend, which live mode refuses.

variables.name: OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME
variables.description: User name for the external OpenCode server.

variables.name: OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the external OpenCode server.

variables.name: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST
variables.description: In-cluster API host the Kubernetes backend and verifier use when kubernetes.apiUrl is unset; Kubernetes sets it.

variables.name: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT
variables.description: In-cluster API port the delivery verifier uses; Kubernetes sets it.

variables.name: KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT_HTTPS
variables.description: In-cluster API port the Kubernetes backend uses; Kubernetes sets it.

variables.name: PATH
variables.description: Passed to git and local agent processes Unfold starts.

variables.name: TMPDIR
variables.description: Temporary directory passed to the demo runtime's processes.

workspaceVariables.description: Variables Unfold sets in an agent workspace for the programs it runs there. Unfold writes them into the workspace environment and never reads them from its own.
